d.ko:
DWARF COMBAT! Stonewards is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn
dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful
upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.

d.zh: 矮人开战！Stonewards 是一款支持 1–4 人合作的第一人称 roguelite 防御游戏。带领一队倔强的矮人从你的大本营出发，援助附近的王国，深入地下采集资源，打造强大的升级，并坚守防线，抵御无情的怪物进攻。
